name: MAR-TATOOSH-1 · Tatoosh Island intertidal (middle zone)
summary: Middle intertidal (mussel-dominated) trophic food web from Tatoosh Island, WA.

provenance.origin: Wootton JT, Sander EL, Allesina S (2016) Data from: What can interaction webs tell us about species roles? Dryad https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.39jv1
provenance.citation: Wootton JT, Sander EL, Allesina S (2016). Data from: What can interaction webs tell us about species roles? PLoS Computational Biology, 12(6), e1004330. Dataset deposited at Dryad: https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.39jv1
provenance.license: Dataset published on Dryad (10.5061/dryad.39jv1). Reuse terms per Dryad license; attribution required. Verify current license terms.
provenance.nodeUnit: Species and some functional groups (as reported)
cleaningNotes: Extracted trophic matrix (110×110) from TatooshTrophic.txt; interpreted +1 as column prey of row => column → row (food source → consumer).
Only feeding links retained; non-feeding entries excluded.
Derived node labels from taxonomy; some groups left as reported.
Trophic roles assigned conservatively (producers/decomposers/other) with roleEvidence="unknown".
No species relationships, citations, or validation results were invented.
